# Schema diagrams

UML-style class diagrams of CESDM schema 1.0.0, generated from `schemas/cesdm`, `schemas/cesdm_power_flow`, `schemas/cesdm_dynamic`: 81 classes. Each view draws one family of classes with their attributes and relations. The tree below shows inheritance only; click a class to open its view.

| View | Classes | What it shows |
|---|---|---|
| [Assets: generation, storage, demand](assets.md) | 12 | Physical assets that inject, withdraw or store energy at one node or region. |
| [Network and transmission](network.md) | 16 | Nodes per carrier domain, the elements that connect them, and the regions and zones they sit in. |
| [Conversion units](conversion.md) | 9 | Assets that link two carrier domains, and their ports. |
| [Technologies, carriers and resources](technologies.md) | 7 | Shared types that assets point to with hasTechnology, hasCarrier or hasInputResource. |
| [System and time series](time-series.md) | 3 | The model container, profiles and the time axis they share. |
| [Dynamic models and controllers](dynamics.md) | 16 | Machine models and the exciters, governors and stabilisers a generator links to. |
| [Results and run records](results.md) | 17 | Outputs of an analysis, linked to the assets they report on, and the run that produced them. |
